pages.text: Every drop is useful. Hides (grazer/dark) craft into leather. Glow Sinew → string. Lumen Algae → green dye. Wraith Membrane → phantom membrane. Mire Tooth → bone meal. Rootback Plate → iron nuggets.

Glow Scales → glow pollen. Shade Claw → echo dust. Crystal Dust → glasspetal block. Moonloam Clumps → moonloam.$(br)$(br)Spore Sac, Glowcap Spores, Air Gel, Glow Pollen and Living Fiber are all $(l:status_effects)brewing$(/l) ingredients.
